authority.source: OWNER decision relayed by the integration lead (2026-10-29): extend the existing Insights publication/provenance path to support independently admitted organisations, using their verified I0 identity and signed source evidence instead of requiring an ECHE university root; no new track or phase, folded into the pending R2-P3 release
scope: The original strategy explicitly prioritises independent student, language and cultural organisations; they are discoverable, eligible for I0, qualifiable and manageable in Track D, and leaving their Track A Insights permanently unpublishable breaks the integrated product requirement.

Preserve all existing privacy, publication, provenance, OWNER approval and signature guarantees; invent no university affiliation; use no unsourced identity join; weaken no existing restriction; keep Insights associated with the general organisation profile under the same visibility and withdrawal semantics as university-rooted cards.
